goal: Build a reproducible benchmark and bounded recursive-improvement system for the Multi-Agent Analytics System, covering both the Analytics Report and HTML Dashboard paths, individual workflow agents, failure handling, and output quality.
description: Four specialist agents collaborate through explicit artifacts: a benchmark architect defines immutable cases and rubrics; a workflow evaluator runs every case; two optimization agents alternate proposals and adversarial critiques without weakening gates. Output quality must score readability, visibility, trustworthiness, and executive suitability.
tasks: Define feature benchmarks for routing, environment-only credentials, checkpointing, retries, branch isolation, analytics stages, HTML dashboard stages, PDF generation, and PowerPoint generation

Define per-agent contract benchmarks for data understanding, research, planning, coding, code review, business translation, decision making, report generation, slide generation, dashboard planning, dashboard rendering, and dashboard QA
Define deterministic output rubrics for readability, visibility, trustworthiness, and executive suitability
Execute every benchmark with structured receipts, durations, pass/fail status, and failure diagnostics
Alternate two bounded optimization agents that propose and critique changes
Reject benchmark weakening, score-only gaming, missing held-out checks, and regressions
Produce human-readable JSON and Markdown benchmark summaries

compliance_requirements: no runtime dependency on Codex self-evolution

safety_requirements: Bound recursive optimization by a configured maximum
Keep benchmark definitions versioned and auditable
Require regression tests before accepting changes
Do not let optimizers edit held-out expected results
Preserve branch isolation and environment-only credentials
Log all proposals, critiques, acceptance decisions, and score deltas
integration_requirements: Existing analytics workflow integration without runtime Codex coupling
